leakage_audit.scope: The executable generic generator and serialized training input only. The broader repository contains prior classical-law fixtures and is not claimed exposure-free.

scope: Exploratory recovery of a known three-column scaling from a real NASA catalog snapshot. The candidate generator sees sanitized training rows only. Because aggregate holdout performance was inspected during implementation and catalog parameters may be inferred or dependent, this receipt cannot unlock Task 2, count as Level 5, establish creative superiority, or confirm the physical law independently.

source.dependency_warning: The archive fields are real published catalog parameters, but some semi-major axes and masses are inferred or model-dependent. They are not treated as three independent direct measurements.

target_opening.data_dependency_warning: Exoplanet catalog semi-major axes and stellar masses may be inferred, model-dependent, or algebraically coupled to periods. Recovery is an instrument calibration on real catalog values, not an independent empirical confirmation of the physical law.
target_opening.equivalence_rule: primitive integer exponent vectors are sign-normalized by requiring the first nonzero entry to be positive; exact vector equality is then required
target_opening.historical_interpretation: Kepler/Newton two-body scaling in archive units
